scientific_integrity: One mathematically formulated claim; exact proof plus a reproducible finite certificate. General simultaneous irreducibility asymptotics and standard Weil results are credited rather than claimed as new. No independent audit or third-party verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Prime fields only; the explicit estimate applies to primes at least eleven; the finite sieve is exact only through 850 but the proof is universal because of the Weil bound. Optimal error constants and monogenicity are not addressed. Earlier implicit coverage remains possible.
title: Simultaneous irreducibility of two reciprocal-sign cubics over every prime field
